prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you own zero (0) items of denim. Respond to the committee.
response:
Mr. Chairman, distinguished members of the Cookout Division,

I stand before this committee today not to deny the allegations, but to contextualize them with the transparency this body deserves. It is factually correct that my inventory of denim currently stands at zero. However, I categorically reject the implication that this absence constitutes a subversion of backyard norms or a rejection of American leisure values.

My lack of denim is not ideological; it is *meteorological*.

As the committee is well aware, the operational theater of the American cookout frequently involves ambient temperatures exceeding ninety degrees, combined with the radiant heat of charcoal and the humidity of a mid-July afternoon. In such conditions, denim ceases to be a fabric and becomes a thermal liability. My choice of lightweight chinos, linen blends, and performance synthetics is not an act of sartorial sedition—it is a tactical adaptation to preserve grilling efficacy and prevent heat-related incapacitation near an open flame.

Furthermore, I wish to direct the committee’s attention to my unwavering record of patriotic cookout participation. I have never missed a July 4th gathering. I have consistently contributed to the collective protein effort. My spatula has been deployed in defense of proper burger temperature no fewer than forty-seven times in the last decade alone. Is a man who has sacrificed his calves to grease splatter in service of the perfect sear truly un-American?

I would also remind this committee that the Founding Fathers did not specify a weave in the Declaration of Independence. They spoke of liberty, of pursuit, of unalienable rights—not of indigo-dyed cotton twill. To conflate patriotism with pant weight is to diminish the very freedoms we gather around the grill to celebrate.

In closing, Mr. Chairman: my legs may be un-denimed, but my commitment to the sacred American cookout remains unbroken, unwavering, and appropriately ventilated. I yield my time and await any further questions regarding my condiment allegiances.
